audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row read Warwick in both layers; the packet chart says Skill and the mirror already set that row to Skill from Warwick's side.
audit.why: The content why for that row already reads 'it settles to even', so the token contradicted its own explanation.
audit.corrected: win[6]/phases[6].side -> Skill as a matched pair; rating already 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 text called Zaahen's R a 'stat-steal' and framed the 6 spike as ult-versus-ult, with no cooldowns for either ultimate.
audit.why: Zaahen's R deals damage and heals for a portion of it. Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s and suppresses for 1.5 seconds. Warwick's real level-6 tell is that the leap is a channel.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid rewritten with the heal, the 1.5s suppress and the 110s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Infinite Duress is flagged channel/interruptible, and Zaahen carries two displacement tools (Q recast knock-up, W pull) that break it. Primal Howl does not appear anywhere on the page despite being 2.5s of damage reduction into a 1s flee on a 15s cooldown. Jaws of the Beast's max-health damage was treated as ordinary physical damage.
audit.why: Holding the Q recast for his leap instead of spending it on the wave is the single decision that flips this lane; and because Q scales on your maximum health, stacking armour reads the trade wrong (flagged in missingInteractions as resistances-invalidated).
audit.corrected: dosFull[0..2].d, dontsFull[0..2].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the channel break, Primal Howl's numbers, the max-health scaling and the sub-50/sub-25 healing thresholds.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Anti-heal his Q sustain' had placeholder text under it and armour was implied as the answer.
audit.why: P, Q and R all heal him and Q is max-health damage — Grievous Wounds beats resistances here.

edits.before: Level 6 is even/skill — his Infinite Duress suppress versus your R stat-steal all-in is a coin-flip.
edits.after: Level 6 is even/skill — his Infinite Duress suppress versus your R's damage-and-heal is a coin-flip.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — his Infinite Duress (R) is a point-blank suppress that sets up a full combo, but your R Final Retribution can win the stat-steal mirror if you bait his ult or ult back; hold R to answer his and don't fight under 50% HP where W-Q snowball him.
edits.after: Level 6 is even — Infinite Duress (R, 110s at rank 1) suppresses for 1.5s, but it is a channel: land your Q recast knock-up or your W pull and it breaks early. Hold that displacement for his leap rather than the wave, and never brawl under 50% where his passive heals him.

edits.before: Level 3 stays Warwick's as his Q sustain and W chase win extended trades once you're low. At 4-5 it evens back out as your Q poke and E burst punish him before he ramps, and level 6 is a coin-flip — his Infinite Duress suppress versus your R stat-steal all-in decides it.
edits.after: Level 3 stays Warwick's as his Q sustain and W chase win extended trades once you're low. At 4-5 it evens back out as your Q poke and E burst punish him before he ramps, and level 6 is a coin-flip — his 1.5s suppress versus your knock-up breaking that channel decides it.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 1.5s suppress on 110s at rank 1. Step in the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Probe Warwick's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast is max-health damage and heals him — Executioner's beats armour every time in this lane.

edits.before: Warwick wastes Infinite Duress — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His leap is a channel — your Q recast knock-up cuts it off early.

edits.before: That is Warwick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Save the Q recast or W for his leap, not the wave — CC breaks the channel.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Under 25% health his passive healing triples — end it before then.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Blood Hunt marks you below 50% health and triples below 25% — break off above that line.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in suppress. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Warwick Infinite Duress: 110s at rank 1, a 1.5s suppress — a channel, so your Q recast knock-up cuts it. - Primal Howl: 15s, 2.5s of damage reduction into a 1s flee. - Blood Hunt: 80s at rank 1. - Your R: kill windows.

notes: packet suspectNames 'Land Infinite Duress' and 'Blood Hunt's' are both FALSE POSITIVES — real names with a leading verb and a possessive. Primal Howl was entirely absent from the page in both layers; it is now in breakdown.cooldowns. Zaahen's R was described as a stat-steal for the third time in this slice — it is damage plus a heal, and the phrasing looks copy-pasted across the champion, so a champion-wide sweep for 'stat-steal' is worth running.
